references.title: Manage data retention in Log Analytics

steps: Inspect the workspace properties.retentionInDays, approved MinRetentionTime and any table-specific overrides with the log owner; confirm which tables inherit the default.

In Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > selected workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Data Retention, or the owning IaC resource, set the default interactive retention to the approved days after cost review.
Verify the workspace value and relevant table overrides after the change; restore the previous approved IaC revision if the change has unintended cost or query impact.
azure_log_analytics_workspace_10_5_1_4_8.summary: Increase the Log Analytics workspace default interactive retention to the approved days.
